sessions.phase_label: Original Meta account restriction diagnosis and recovery attempts
Meta support escalation and selection of an alternative account path
Alternative account and Facebook ads management planning

requirements.title: Restore Ad Access on Original Account
requirements.definition: Restore the client's ability to run Facebook ads from the original account by resolving the profile-level Meta restriction.
requirements.boundary_note: Identity verification, 2FA changes, support contacts, appeals, and account-access methods are recovery steps or constraints rather than independently requested deliverables.

requirements.title: Set Up Alternative Account for Ad Access
requirements.definition: Configure an alternative Facebook account, identified as the client's sister's account, so the client can use it to run Facebook ads.
requirements.boundary_note: Identity documents, initial login, 2FA activation, authentication codes, and adding another email are setup parameters or steps of one alternative-account mechanism. Ongoing campaign management is independently actionable and remains separate.

requirements.title: Manage Facebook Ad Campaigns
requirements.definition: Provide ongoing management of the client's Facebook advertising campaigns after suitable account access is established.
requirements.boundary_note: Campaign management is separate from restoring or configuring account access because it can be requested, deferred, and performed independently once access exists.

unresolved_candidates.description: The client asks for campaign management without involving the sister, while the freelancer says the sister is still required for the initial meeting and 2FA codes. The client does not subsequently confirm this qualified access arrangement.
